items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I said, “Boy, that would be nice. Let me sit in with you guys.”

ctx.x: She was doing one of Michel Legrand’s tunes. I said, “Boy, that would be nice. Let me sit in with you guys.” She said, “Oh yeah.” So we ended up playing together. From then on, she said wow. So we’ve done gigs. We did The Anthology down there in San Diego, and we did Yakima, Washington. We did UCLA twice, and we did the Grammy museum. So we’re already playing. Now we’re getting ready to do Tempe, Arizona, on the – yeah, like I told you, that conflict I had. That is going to be on the 15th of April.

I used the word plethora. I should have used dearth or scarcity. So you’re able to pick and choose the gigs you want. It seems like you even run the risk of overbooking. You’re able to work both nationally and internationally, to your satisfaction?
